guides.note-cards.md:
# Note cards

Use decisionCard or projectBrief Otion markers with string fields. Preserve unknown fields and blocks. Run the workspace validator and review the diff after edits. The optional executable views use the same portable data. The package reads the active page for statistics and stores its focus counter locally; it cannot access arbitrary files or the network.
